_about: Labelled micro-benchmark for A/B-ing the Bastet harness. The upstream Bastet dataset (450 Code4rena repos) is distributed via Google Drive and is not in the repository, so this self-contained set stands in for it. Every vulnerable case is paired with a functionally equivalent safe case, which is what makes the false-positive rate measurable: a harness that shouts 'slippage!' at every swap scores well on the vulnerable half and terribly here.

cases.note: swapExactTokensForTokens called with amountOutMin hardcoded to 0
same vault; minWantOut and deadline are caller-supplied and re-checked after the swap
